changes.to: The maker's Proxie page describes Glide 360 swerve drive, a Flex Grasp gripper, hot-swappable batteries, a vertical spine and an optional bimanual arm kit, but publishes no dimensions, weight, payload or speed. Press coverage quotes 1,500 lb cart towing and 220 lb spine lift and a USD 5,000-per-month subscription; those figures are not maker-published specifications, so no numeric fields are filled.
Wheeled mobile manipulator with a vertical spine and optional dual arms for hospital, warehouse and line-side cart and tote handling.
